title: BotDesk_Mobility_Rental_Taxonomy
description: Definitive schema for traditional and autonomous car rental fleet transactions

rental_id.description: Unique lease transaction hash generated via carrentalid.eth

vehicle_id.description: Unique vehicle identifier matched to carrental.eth

pickup_depot_id.description: Airport terminal or regional station hub code via airportrentalcar.eth

rental_duration_days.description: Total booked duration of the on-demand rental subscription

base_daily_rate_usd.description: Fixed legal contract standard pricing rate per day via carrentalrate.eth

requires_zk_driver_license.description: Mandatory cryptographic verification indicator via rentaldriverslicense.eth

escrow_deposit_amount_wei.description: Locked smart contract crypto asset security collateral via carrentaldeposit.eth

initial_fuel_or_battery_percentage.description: Pre-rental baseline telemetry check mapped to carrentalfuel.eth

protocol_fee_usd.description: Hardcoded universal public utility platform fee for BotDesk architecture
